episodes.title: Pilot
episodes.summary: When Lucy's quiet life in the countryside is violently interrupted by forces from her past, she must escape to the city with her new chosen family to find answers, only to meet a familiar young woman who begs even more questions.

episodes.title: Jules
episodes.summary: Lucy forces Jules to go to Settlement House where she enlists Craig's help in a haphazard interrogation. Kira receives an unexpected visit from a family member. Billionaire Paul Darros raises alarm with his team in his search for Lucy.

episodes.title: Pegasus Girl
episodes.summary: Jules begins to question her past, taking Wes on a journey to investigate. Lucy and Jack chase down a lead that may reveal Jules' origin. And Kira confronts Darros about his handling of Lucy.

episodes.title: It's All Coming Back
episodes.summary: With Jack supervising, Lucy and Jules turn to extreme measures to excavate a shared memory that may contain clues to their past. Kira encounters Emily at a Darros Foundation event and discovers she may be more friend than foe.

episodes.title: Do I Know You?
episodes.summary: 30 years in the past, Kira's groundbreaking research captures the attention of Paul Darros as well as the affection of Professor Eleanor Miller.

episodes.title: Unless You Trusted Someone
episodes.summary: After being kidnapped and taken to a mysterious compound, Jules attempts to escape captivity with the help of an unusual new friend, while Lucy and Kira chase down a lead looking to uncover how Jules was created.

episodes.title: The Dog's Honest Truth
episodes.summary: Kira confronts hard truths when the printout she made of Eleanor meets Lucy, while Jules tries to turn the tables on Darros and Xander to escape the compound.

episodes.title: The Paradox of Joyce
episodes.summary: Kira meets with Emily and realizes her loyalties are divided, while Lucy and Craig track down Lucy's old flame to help unlock Darros security token. Jules and Eleanor reconnect with their closest relative and get a grim look at their future.

episodes.title: Attracting Awful Things
episodes.summary: Lucy nurses Craig's gunshot wound as he fights for his life, Xander has a revelation while on the memory drug that may cause him to abandon his loyalty to Darros, and Kira gets closer to uncovering Darros' master plan.

episodes.title: We Will Come Again
episodes.summary: After Charlie is kidnapped Lucy is left with a difficult choice, Kira and Eleanor finally uncover the connection between the 12 unidentifiable files and Darros' bigger plan but it may be too late to stop him
